simple.meaning: סָרָה (çârâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “apostasy , crime ; figuratively, remission.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 8 times in Deuteronomy, Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at Deuteronomy 13:6. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, righteousness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סָרָה (H5627) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: סָרָה (çârâh) / H5627 is traced through Deuteronomy 13:6, Deuteronomy 19:16, Isaiah 1:5, Isaiah 14:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

timeline.evidenceText: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;
If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,
Why should you be beaten more,
who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.
Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.
Therefore Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth. This year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against Yahweh.’ ”

therefore Yahweh says, “Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring. He will not have a man to dwell among this people. He won’t see the good that I will do to my people,” says Yahweh, “because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh.” ’ ”

definitions.full: H5627. sarah סָרָה noun feminine a turning aside, defection, apostasy, withdrawal ; — always absolute ׳ס ; — 1 defection , used apparently of any moral or legal offence Deut 19:16 , so probably Isa 59:13 (+ שָׁ֑קֶר דִּבְרֵי עשֶׁק, ). 2 apostasy , Deut 13:6 ; Isa 1:5 ; 31:6 ; Jer 28:16 ; 29:32 . 3 בִּלְתִּי סָרָה non-withdrawal Isa 14:6 (compare verb, 14:25 ; Amos 6:7 ). סִרָה see הַסּ ׳בּוֺר above יסור , only in יסורי Jer 17:13 Kt, but see Qr סור Qal Participle
